Company level · Foundation and Temple · mockup for sign-off

Themes move to the Foundation, and the Temple only shows

Real screenshots of the platform with the change drawn in. Anything new is outlined in gold. Nothing here is built yet.

1 · Foundation, while editing

  • A Themes box under Key Objectives. Each theme has a code, a name and a note, plus how many pillars use it. A theme that a pillar uses says In use and can't be removed. One that isn't used has Remove. + Add a theme adds one.
  • A Heading column in Key Objectives. This is what the Temple groups objectives under, for example "Market share". Today only the Temple's own Edit can set it.
  • The Themes box only appears on the company level, and only while Themes are switched on in set-up.

2 · Foundation, while reading

The themes show as three cards between the objectives and Core Values: code, name and note.

3 · Temple

  • The Edit button goes. The Temple looks exactly as it does now, but it only shows what's written elsewhere.
  • The aspiration, the objectives and their headings, and the themes come from the Foundation. The capabilities along the base come from the Capabilities section under Strategy.

To decide

  1. Is the Foundation as drawn OK: the Themes box between Key Objectives and Core Values, and the three cards when reading?
  2. Is Heading the right word for the objectives column? Today the Temple calls it "Group", which reads oddly where the top level is also called Group.
  3. Is the Temple with no Edit OK?
